notes: Unit is the ROS 2 rolling RMW implementation rmw_zenoh_cpp 0.8.2; the snapshot also holds zenoh_cpp_vendor and zenoh_security_tools, which were not treated as the unit. The four api:* elements are C functions defined inside the extern "C" block of rmw_zenoh.cpp (lines 118-2724) and rmw_get_topic_endpoint_info.cpp (26-95); the prototypes they implement live in the rmw package headers (rmw/rmw.h, rmw/get_topic_endpoint_info.h), which are not in the snapshot and were not fetched (not a permitted source), so conformance of these signatures to the rmw headers was not checked. Ports for api:* elements carry msg_type/frame/units/qos/rate/definition_id = null because they are type-agnostic C API symbols, not data streams. QoS for publishers/subscriptions created through rmw_create_publisher/rmw_create_subscription is caller-supplied at run time, so it is not statically determined; the code's rule: detail/qos.cpp best_available_qos maps history SYSTEM_DEFAULT/UNKNOWN->KEEP_LAST, depth 0->42, reliability SYSTEM_DEFAULT/UNKNOWN->RELIABLE, durability SYSTEM_DEFAULT/UNKNOWN->VOLATILE, default deadline/lifespan/lease->RMW_DURATION_INFINITE, liveliness SYSTEM_DEFAULT/UNKNOWN->AUTOMATIC (qos.cpp:18-47,99-148); BEST_AVAILABLE reliability/durability fall through the switch unchanged, and the peer-discovery callback (rmw_get_subscriptions_info_by_topic for publishers, rmw_publisher_data.cpp:64-65; rmw_get_publishers_info_by_topic for subscriptions, rmw_subscription_data.cpp:68) is passed but deliberately unused (qos.cpp:84-93). Publisher transport: congestion control DROP, BLOCK only for RELIABLE+KEEP_ALL; zenoh reliability RELIABLE only when reliability==RELIABLE else BEST_EFFORT; TRANSIENT_LOCAL enables a publisher cache of depth samples (rmw_publisher_data.cpp:117-143). rmw_get_publishers_info_by_topic / rmw_get_subscriptions_info_by_topic delegate to GraphCache::get_entities_info_by_topic with EntityType::Publisher / Subscription (rmw_get_topic_endpoint_info.cpp:54-59, 88-93).
